import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_deaths_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR ENROLL AB 33_CPS_02ENR', header=None)

months = header_row[2:].values

max_idx = counts.argmax()

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_program_stats_deaths_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='MDCR ENROLL AB 35_CPS_02ENR', header=None)
start_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Alabama'].index[0]
end_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Wyoming'].index[0]
states_df = df.iloc[start_idx:end_idx+1].copy()
states_df = states_df[states_df[0].astype(str).str.strip() != 'District of Columbia']
states_df[1] = pd.to_numeric(states_df[1])
top3 = states_df.sort_values(by=1, ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3[0].str.strip().tolist()
